title: Set Edge Aesthetics — sn_edges
text: network cograph_network object, matrix, data.frame, igraph object. Matrices inputs auto-converted. width Edge width. Can single value, vector (per-edge), "weight". edge_size Base edge size weight scaling. NULL (default) uses adaptive sizing based network size: 15 * exp(-n_nodes/90) + 1. Larger values = thicker edges. esize Deprecated. Use edge_size instead. edge_width_range Output width range c(min, max) weight-based scaling. Default c(0.5, 4). Edges scaled fit within range. edge_scale_mode Scaling mode edge weights: "linear" (default), "log" (wide weight ranges), "sqrt" (moderate compression), "rank" (equal visual spacing). edge_cutoff Two-tier cutoff edge width scaling. NULL (default) = auto 75th percentile. 0 = disabled. Positive number = manual threshold. cut Deprecated. Use edge_cutoff instead. color Edge color. Can single color, vector, "weight" automatic coloring based edge weights. edge_positive_color Color positive edge weights. positive_color Deprecated. Use edge_positive_color instead. edge_negative_color Color negative edge weights. negative_color Deprecated. Use edge_negative_color instead. alpha Edge transparency (0-1). style Line style: "solid", "dashed", "dotted", "longdash", "twodash". curvature Edge curvature amount (0 = straight). arrow_size Size arrow heads directed networks. show_arrows Logical. Show arrows? Default TRUE directed networks. maximum Maximum edge weight scaling width. Weights capped. Similar qgraph's maximum parameter. width_scale Scale factor edge widths. Values > 1 make edges thicker, values < 1 make thinner. Applied width calculations. labels Edge labels. Can TRUE (show weights), vector, column name. label_size Edge label text size. label_color Edge label text color. label_position Position along edge (0 = source, 0.5 = middle, 1 = target). label_offset Perpendicular offset edge line. label_bg Background color edge labels (default "white"). Set NA transparent. label_bg_padding Padding around label text proportion text size (default 0.3). label_fontface Font face: "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic" (default "plain"). label_border Border style: NULL (none), "rect", "rounded", "circle" (default NULL). label_border_color Border color label border (default "gray50"). label_underline Logical. Underline label text? (default FALSE). label_shadow Logical. Enable drop shadow labels? (default FALSE). label_shadow_color Color label shadow (default "gray40"). label_shadow_offset Offset distance shadow points (default 0.5). label_shadow_alpha Transparency shadow (0-1, default 0.5). bidirectional Logical. Show arrows ends edges? loop_rotation Angle radians self-loop direction (default: pi/2 = top). curve_shape Spline tension curved edges (-1 1, default: 0). curve_pivot Pivot position along edge curve control point (0-1, default: 0.5). curves Curve mode: FALSE (straight edges), "mutual" (curve reciprocal pairs), "force" (curve edges). Default FALSE. ci Numeric vector CI widths (0-1 scale). Larger values = uncertainty. ci_scale Width multiplier CI underlay thickness. Default 2. ci_alpha Transparency CI underlay (0-1). Default 0.15. ci_color CI underlay color. NA (default) uses main edge color. ci_style Line type CI underlay: 1=solid, 2=dashed, 3=dotted. Default 2. ci_arrows Logical: show arrows CI underlay? Default FALSE. ci_lower Numeric vector lower CI bounds labels. ci_upper Numeric vector upper CI bounds labels. label_style Preset style: "none", "estimate", "full", "range", "stars". label_template Template placeholders: {est}, {range}, {low}, {}, {p}, {stars}. label_digits Decimal places estimates template. Default 2. label_ci_format CI format: "bracket" [low, ] "dash" low-. label_p Numeric vector p-values edges. label_p_digits Decimal places p-values. Default 3. label_p_prefix Prefix p-values. Default "p=". label_stars Stars labels: character vector, TRUE (compute p), numeric (treated p-values).

title: Plot Cograph Network — soplot
text: network cograph_network object, matrix, data.frame, igraph object. Matrices inputs auto-converted. title Optional plot title. title_size Title font size. margins Plot margins c(bottom, left, top, right). layout_margin Margin around network layout (proportion viewport). Default 0.15. newpage Logical. Start new graphics page? Default TRUE. background Background color plot. Default "white". layout Layout algorithm. Built-: "circle", "spring", "groups", "grid", "random", "star", "bipartite". igraph (2-letter): "kk" (Kamada-Kawai), "fr" (Fruchterman-Reingold), "drl", "mds", "ni" (nicely), "tr" (tree), etc. Can also pass coordinate matrix igraph layout function directly. theme Theme name: "classic", "dark", "minimal", etc. seed Random seed deterministic layouts. Default 42. Set NULL random. labels Node labels. Can character vector set custom labels. threshold Minimum absolute edge weight display. Edges abs(weight) < threshold hidden. Similar qgraph's threshold. maximum Maximum edge weight width scaling. Weights capped. Similar qgraph's maximum parameter. node_size Node size. node_shape Node shape: "circle", "square", "triangle", "diamond", "ellipse", "heart", "star", "pie", "donut", "cross". node_fill Node fill color. node_border_color Node border color. node_border_width Node border width. node_alpha Node transparency (0-1). label_size Node label text size. label_color Node label text color. label_position Label position: "center", "", "", "left", "right". show_labels Logical. Show node labels? pie_values pie/donut/donut_pie nodes: list matrix values segments. donut single value (0-1), shows proportion filled. pie_colors pie/donut/donut_pie nodes: colors pie segments. pie_border_width Border width pie chart segments. donut_values donut_pie nodes: vector values (0-1) outer ring proportion. donut_border_width Border width donut ring. donut_inner_ratio donut nodes: inner radius ratio (0-1). Default 0.5. donut_bg_color donut nodes: background color unfilled portion. donut_show_value donut nodes: show value center? Default FALSE. donut_value_size donut nodes: font size center value. donut_value_color donut nodes: color center value text. donut_fill Numeric value (0-1) donut fill proportion. simplified API creating donut charts. Can single value vector per node. donut_color Fill color(s) donut ring. Simplified API: single color fill, c(fill, background) . donut_colors Deprecated. Use donut_color instead. donut_shape Base shape donut: "circle", "square", "hexagon", "triangle", "diamond", "pentagon". Default inherits node_shape. donut_value_fontface Font face donut center value: "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic". Default "bold". donut_value_fontfamily Font family donut center value. Default "sans". donut_value_digits Decimal places donut center value. Default 2. donut_value_prefix Text donut center value (e.g., "$"). Default "". donut_value_suffix Text donut center value (e.g., "%"). Default "". donut2_values List values inner donut ring (double donut). donut2_colors List color vectors inner donut ring segments. donut2_inner_ratio Inner radius ratio inner donut ring. Default 0.4. edge_width Edge width. NULL, scales weight using edge_size edge_width_range. edge_size Base edge size weight scaling. NULL (default) uses adaptive sizing based network size: 15 * exp(-n_nodes/90) + 1. Larger values = thicker edges. esize Deprecated. Use edge_size instead. edge_width_range Output width range c(min, max) weight-based scaling. Default c(0.5, 4). Edges scaled fit within range. edge_scale_mode Scaling mode edge weights: "linear" (default), "log" (wide weight ranges), "sqrt" (moderate compression), "rank" (equal visual spacing). edge_cutoff Two-tier cutoff edge width scaling. NULL (default) = auto 75th percentile. 0 = disabled. Positive number = manual threshold. cut Deprecated. Use edge_cutoff instead. edge_width_scale Scale factor edge widths. Values > 1 make edges thicker. edge_color Edge color. edge_alpha Edge transparency (0-1). edge_style Line style: "solid", "dashed", "dotted". curvature Edge curvature amount. arrow_size Size arrow heads. show_arrows Logical. Show arrows? edge_positive_color Color positive edge weights. positive_color Deprecated. Use edge_positive_color instead. edge_negative_color Color negative edge weights. negative_color Deprecated. Use edge_negative_color instead. edge_duplicates handle duplicate edges undirected networks. NULL (default) = stop error listing duplicates. Options: "sum", "mean", "first", "max", "min", custom aggregation function. edge_labels Edge labels. Can TRUE show weights, vector. edge_label_size Edge label text size. edge_label_color Edge label text color. edge_label_position Position along edge (0 = source, 0.5 = middle, 1 = target). edge_label_offset Perpendicular offset edge line. edge_label_bg Background color edge labels (default "white"). Set NA transparent. edge_label_fontface Font face: "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic". edge_label_border Border style: NULL, "rect", "rounded", "circle". edge_label_border_color Border color label border. edge_label_underline Logical. Underline label text? bidirectional Logical. Show arrows ends edges? loop_rotation Angle radians self-loop direction (default: pi/2 = top). curve_shape Spline tension curved edges (-1 1, default: 0). curve_pivot Pivot position along edge curve control point (0-1, default: 0.5). curves Curve mode: TRUE (default) = single edges straight, reciprocal edges curve ellipse (two opposing curves); FALSE = straight; "force" = curved. node_names Alternative names legend (separate display labels). legend Logical. Show legend? legend_position Legend position: "topright", "topleft", "bottomright", "bottomleft". scaling Scaling mode: "default" qgraph-matched scaling node_size=6 looks similar qgraph vsize=6, "legacy" preserve pre-v2.0 behavior. weight_digits Number decimal places round edge weights plotting. Edges round zero automatically removed. Default 2. Set NULL disable rounding.

text: Edge curving controlled three parameters interact: curves Mode automatic curving. title: Base R Graphics Network Plotting — splot
text: Controls edge weights mapped visual widths: linear (default) Width proportional weight. Best weights similar magnitude. log Logarithmic scaling. Best weights span multiple orders magnitude (e.g., 0.01 100). sqrt Square root scaling. Moderate compression, good moderately skewed distributions. rank Rank-based scaling. Ignores actual values; uses relative ordering. edges get equal visual spacing regardless weight distribution.

what: Donut vs Pie vs Double Donut
title: Base R Graphics Network Plotting — splot
text: Three ways show additional data nodes: Donut (donut_fill) Single ring showing proportion (0-1). Ideal completion rates, probabilities, single metric per node. Use donut_color fill color donut_bg_color unfilled portion. Pie (pie_values) Multiple colored segments showing category breakdown. Ideal composition data. Values normalized sum 1. Use pie_colors segment colors. Double Donut (donut2_values) Two concentric rings comparing two metrics per node. Outer ring uses donut_fill/donut_color, inner ring uses donut2_values/donut2_colors.

title: cograph 1.7.0

text: Fixed soplot() curve direction edge defaults diverging splot() behavior Fixed rescale_layout distorting oval aspect ratios switching uniform scaling Fixed edge scaling producing abnormally thick edges small networks Fixed par(pin) restoration error plot device exit

title: cograph 1.1.0
text: Added splot() — base R graphics engine network visualization using polygon(), lines(), xspline(), providing better performance grid-based rendering large networks Added polygon-shaped donut nodes, custom SVG node shapes, AI-generated shape support Added shadow/halo labels fine-grained text control (fontface, fontfamily, hjust, vjust, angle) Added double donut nodes separate inner/outer border controls Added edge CI (confidence interval) underlays template-based edge labels Added comprehensive legend support: groups, edge color scales, node size scales Added high-resolution output via sn_save() configurable DPI Added edge curve modes, bidirectional arrows, self-loop rotation, per-edge curve control

title: cograph 1.1.0
text: Fixed donut rendering producing artifacts simplified donut_color API accept 1 color (fill), 2 colors (fill + background), n colors (per-node) Fixed arrow positioning curve direction qgraph-style edges Fixed edge label positioning avoid overlap edge lines Fixed self-loop rendering use qgraph-style circular arcs Fixed arrow placement non-square viewports Fixed reciprocal edge auto-separation causing edge crossings
